generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that none of their contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of their default in KPCL or elsewhere during last ten years. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that their offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that I have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that I have submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.
The bidder shall furnish copies of the following statutory documents, Income tax PAN.GST registration certificate, Labour license certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The bidder shall have carried out similar work or supply/erection/maintenance of 11kv HT line and as proof of the above, a copy of work order cum Work done certificate worth of Rs 19.4 lakhs executed in single work order in any one of the preceding Five years. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 and 2025-26). As a proof of this the bidder shall upload work order and relevant work done certificate issued by an officer of the rank of Chief Engineer / Competent authority. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).
The bidder shall furnish copies of the following statutory documents, Income tax PAN.GST registration certificate, Labour license certificate

The bidder shall have minimum average annual turnover of Rs 38.80 Lakhs in any two of preceding five years. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 and 2025-26)As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload copies of turnover certificate or profit & losses statement duly certified by chartered accountant.( Financial turnover for previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited)

Excavation of cable trench 50 cm wide and 60 cm deep trench for laying UG cable including back filling the trench with excavated material in layers and compacting after laying cables etc., complete.In all kinds of soil.

Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of
unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness(.i) By Mechanical Means using Dozer, ii) In area of light jungle

Spreading of fly ash: Supplying and providing fly ash/bottom ash in the station yard or wherever required including watering, ramming, consolidating and dressing. The rate includes the cost of material, labour charges, required tools and plants etc., complete. Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of Engineer-in-charge of works as per the standard procedure.

Providing and filling murrum / gravelly soil ( CNS soil ) for foundation or around pipes including cost of all materials, labour, spreading soil in layers of 100 to 150 mm, breaking clods, watering, compaction by earth masters to achieve density control of not less than 90 percent and all other ancillary operations complete.

Jelly Spreading (20-25 mm) : Supplying and providing jelly in the station yard of uniform thickness of 100 mm including the cost of materials, labour charges, required tools and plants etc., complete. Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of Engineering- charge of works as per the standard procedure

Providing and fixing G.I. chain link fabric fencing of required width in mesh size 50x50 mm including strengthening with 2 mm dia wire or nuts, bolts and washers as required complete as per the direction of Engineering- charge. (Made of G.I. wire of dia. 4 mm, PVC coated to achieve outer dia not less than 5 mm in required colour and shade)

Supplying, fixing & wiring earth electrodes for grounding conduits, IC, cutouts and other equipment’s using 2.5 mtr long 40mm dia, 2.9mm thick GI pipe provided with 12mm dia, staggered through holes, buried in pit with salt and charcoal placed in alternate layers all-round the pipe for width of 150 mm for full depth and connecting the pipe to the conduit by GI wire using GI bolts nuts & washers, including excavating and refilling the pit etc. the pipe shall have 16 through holes of 12mm dia

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for leveling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.
